MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  July 10, 2017

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by CHAIRMAN YOO.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIRMAN YOO led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Chair Yoo, Carman, Schachter, Scott, Zigrang

  Commissioners Absent:  Medawar

  Staff Present:  Planning Director Wahba, Planning Technician/Code
  Administrator Slawson

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING OF JUNE 5, 2017.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A. WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL RESOLUTIONS THAT ARE PRESENTED FOR THE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ON TONIGHT’S AGENDA AND ALL
  SUCH RESOLUTIONS SHALL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCOTT,

  TO APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM 6-A.

  B. BIANNUAL CODE ENFORCEMENT REPORT, DATED JULY 10, 2017

  Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson summarized the report (as per written
  material).

  In response to a question from COMMISSIONER SCOTT regarding 26 Encanto Drive,
  Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson stated that a stop work order has been
  issued for the property since there are no active permits on file. Planning Director Wahba
  further explained that the property owner went through Building Plancheck and never returned
  to the City for Zone Clearance and therefore, did not finish the process to obtain permits.

  Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson stated that the property at 22 Deerhill Lane
  was red-tagged due to the heavy storms; and 36 Encanto Drive had significant damage due
  to a slide from the hillside. The City is working with the property owners in order to have
  repairs completed before the next rainy season.

  In a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Planning Director Wahba stated that initially the
  City did some emergency work to prevent more damage to the property.

  Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson stated that the City is seeking
  reimbursement from FEMA and Cal OES.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG to,

  1
Planning Commission Minutes
July 10, 2017
   RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM NO. 4B, THE BIANNUAL CODE ENFORCEMENT
  REPORT.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 11-17; APPLICANT: MR. AND MRS. JORGENSEN;
  LOCATION: 8 BUCKSKIN LANE; A request to approve a Neighborhood Compatibility
  Determination and a Variance to replace an existing legal nonconforming 5’ high swimming
  pool fence, all located within the front yard.

  Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson summarized the Staff Report (as per
  written material) and added that the three-rail fence will need to be at the front property
  line.

  Planning Director Wahba stated that this is a unique situation since a Variance was
  approved contrary to what the applicant is requesting because the Neighborhood
  Compatibility Determination was not supported. In addition, the applicant has 30 days to
  accept the Conditions of Approval and 20-days to appeal the decision.

  Planning Director Wahba stated that at the last meeting, the public hearing was closed,
  however the decision on a meeting date was not decided until the end of the meeting.
  Staff noticed the meeting as a Public Meeting. The applicant asked for a continuance of
  this item. Planning Director Wahba let the applicant know that the request would have to
  be made in writing and there was no further response from the applicant.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if there is any benefit in continuing this item to the next
  Planning Commission meeting. Planning Director Wahba stated that the Planning
  Commission should discuss the Conditions of Approval and if there is anything that needs
  to be changed, then the item could be continued.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN asked if there is anything specific that the applicant is
  opposed to. Planning Director Wahba stated that nothing specific has been mentioned to
  staff on the conditions for approval as proposed.

  Dennis Ault, 14 Buckskin, expressed his opposition for this fence and stated that it does
  not comply with the Home Owners Associations’ standards.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG,

  TO ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. PA-11-17.

  Ayes: CHAIR YOO, CARMAN, SCHACHTER, SCOTT, ZIGRANG
  Noes:
  Absent: MEDAWAR
  Abstain:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
  Application No. 11-17, there is a 20-day appeal period.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT inquired about a storage area for sand that has been built by
  the Country Club on Narbonne Ave. Planning Director Wahba stated that he will look into
  it. Planning Technician/Code Administrator Slawson stated that she has a meeting with the
  new Superintendent for the project and will also look into it.

  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG inquired about the grading project in Larga Vista. Planning
  Director Wahba stated that it is now under construction.

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Director Wahba stated that due to lack of items, that the August 7th Planning Commission
  meeting can be cancelled.

  2
Planning Commission Minutes
July 10, 2017
   The Planning Commission agreed to cancel the Planning Commission meeting of August
  7, 2017.

  The Planning Commission discussed holding the meeting at a date to be determined in
  September. Planning Director Wahba stated that an e-mail will be sent to the Planning
  Commission to confirm a date.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated for the future the 2018 calendar should be adjusted to
  avoid conflicts with observed holidays.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 13, 2017.

  B. DRAFT PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, JUNE 19, 2017.

  C. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 27, 2017.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-C.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIRMAN YOO adjourned the meeting at 7:35 p.m.
